defines.name: SHA256_EXP
defines.value: (a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, j) { t1 = wv[h] + SHA256_F2(wv[e]) + CH(wv[e], wv[f], wv[g]) + sha256_k[j] + w[j]; t2 = SHA256_F1(wv[a]) + MAJ(wv[a], wv[b], wv[c]); wv[d] += t1; wv[h] = t1 + t2; }

defines.name: SHA512_EXP
defines.value: (a, b, c, d, e, f, g ,h, j) { t1 = wv[h] + SHA512_F2(wv[e]) + CH(wv[e], wv[f], wv[g]) + sha512_k[j] + w[j]; t2 = SHA512_F1(wv[a]) + MAJ(wv[a], wv[b], wv[c]); wv[d] += t1; wv[h] = t1 + t2; }
